# Accounts in the job line

Milestone 5, 2026-10-28. [All run sets](README.md), [previous: Synthetic job after the eval](2026-10-27-2306-synthetic-job-after-the-eval.md), [next: Drills without an apply](2026-10-28-1747-drills-without-an-apply.md).

**Tested:** Whether a schema built from the accounts the dispatch step names gets a verdict under each name, and a job with no checks' verdicts fails before it runs.

**Changed since the run set before:** The dispatch step reads the job's accounts from the checks' verdicts and names them in the job line, and the job program requires a verdict under each name ([ADR 0051](../decisions/0051-a-netbox-jobs-schema-names-each-account-of-the-job.md)), since `fafe39b`. The template runs the dispatch image the pipeline pushed from `b9de301`.

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Model | Qwen3.5-4B, thinking off |
| Agent | Goose 1.56.0 |
| Task | `collectors/netbox/task.txt` at `fafe39b`, on the seed's access specification after the fix |
| Limits | 1200 seconds and 8 turns |
